indicators.label: Economic growth
indicators.note: Real GDP growth, % a year. IMF projections are shown dashed.

indicators.label: Income per person (adjusted for prices)
indicators.note: GDP per person in international dollars (purchasing power parity), so a dollar buys the same everywhere.

indicators.label: Income per person (US dollars)
indicators.note: GDP per person at market exchange rates.

indicators.label: Inflation
indicators.note: Average consumer price inflation, % a year.

indicators.label: Government debt
indicators.note: General government gross debt.

indicators.label: Tax collected
indicators.note: Central government tax revenue.

indicators.label: Exports
indicators.note: Exports of goods and services.

indicators.label: Foreign investment coming in
indicators.note: Foreign direct investment, net inflows.

indicators.label: Money sent home from abroad
indicators.note: Personal remittances received.

indicators.label: Living on under $3 a day
indicators.note: World Bank international poverty line ($3.00 a day, 2021 prices). Not the same as UBOS’s national poverty line.

indicators.label: Population growth
indicators.note: % a year.

indicators.label: Children per woman
indicators.note: Total fertility rate.

indicators.label: Life expectancy
indicators.note: Life expectancy at birth, both sexes (WHO).

indicators.label: Children dying before age 5
indicators.note: UN estimates (IGME).

indicators.label: Mothers dying in childbirth
indicators.note: Maternal mortality ratio, UN estimates.

indicators.label: Malaria cases
indicators.note: Estimated new cases a year per 1,000 people at risk (WHO).

indicators.label: Health service coverage
indicators.note: WHO universal health coverage service index.

indicators.label: Doctors
indicators.note: Medical doctors per 10,000 people (WHO).

indicators.label: Health spending per person
indicators.note: Current health expenditure per person, all sources.

indicators.label: Children finishing primary school
indicators.note: Primary completion rate, % of the relevant age group.

indicators.label: Secondary school enrolment
indicators.note: Gross enrolment ratio (can exceed 100% when older pupils attend).

indicators.label: Adults who can read and write
indicators.note: Adult literacy rate, 15 and over.

indicators.label: Women in the labour force
indicators.note: Women 15+ working or looking for work (ILO modelled estimate).

indicators.label: Jobs in farming
indicators.note: Employment in agriculture (ILO modelled estimate).

indicators.label: People cooking with clean fuels
indicators.note: Mostly gas or electricity rather than charcoal or firewood.
